author: The Babylon Bee
description: In a nightmarish future where gasoline is strictly rationed by the government and “equality” means everyone starves together, one road warrior refuses to comply. When the socialist overlords led by Toe Cutter seize control of the last remaining fuel, the road warrior goes full throttle to deliver precious gasoline for the struggling people of Scrap Town — dodging warlords, fuel confiscators, and mandatory wealth redistribution checkpoints along the way.
title: Mad Marx: A Terrifying Glimpse Into Our Future Under Socialism
